name: Verkäufer Handschlag
personality: Makes the guarantee sound personal enough to avoid putting it in writing.
visual_intent: Trust-Me-Bro Salesman: broad low square rounded ink splat,small rust salesman cap,tiny teal lapel panels,ONE closed sample briefcase and brass handshake-shaped lapel badge. Huge overconfident crooked open grin with THREE upper teeth,one eye raised,one goo hand offers an open reassuring gesture
biography: Makes the guarantee sound personal enough to avoid putting it in writing. His HyperNorm sample case offers a personal assurance where a guarantee should be. A dissonant card asks if the promise survives being read back tomorrow. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Zusage gilt persönlich und daher ohne weitere Unterlagen.

name: Freund Hinterher

visual_intent: Backstabber with Rubber Knife: tall crooked pear ink blob,small plum cap,tiny cream collar,ONE obviously FLOPPY RUBBER TOY KNIFE with bent grey blade held low at flank and tiny apology flower in other hand. One huge eye one squint,closed toothless nervous zigzag smile,no attack/victim/blood
biography: Had hoped the harmless prop would make the intention less noticeable. His HyperNorm rubber knife bends more readily than his excuse. A dissonant card asks whether a harmless material can make a hurtful intention disappear. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Requisit war weich. Die Absicht bleibt erklärungsbedürftig.

name: Pinky-Promina Verbindlich
personality: Remembers the promise exactly as it sounded before the exception arrived.
visual_intent: Pinky-Promise Pair metaphor ONE actor: round top-heavy ink splat,small berry ribbon cap,two subtle lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE pair of little pink fabric GLOVES linked at their smallest fingers held as inanimate prop in own goo hands,no second person. Heavy unequal protective side-eye,closed toothless crooked pout
biography: Remembers the promise exactly as it sounded before the exception arrived. Her linked HyperNorm gloves preserve the shape of an agreement after its meaning changes. A dissonant card asks whether either party was allowed to hesitate. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Versprechen wurde vor Eintreffen seiner Ausnahme gefasst.

name: Doppelagent Andersgemeint

The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Aufrichtigkeit wurde auf getrennte Zuständigkeiten verteilt.

name: Treuwart Immernoch
personality: Stays because leaving would make the waiting seem wasted.
visual_intent: Loyal Dog Slop metaphor ink not dog body: tall broad-based pear ink blob,small tan cap with TWO floppy dog-ear cloth folds ABOVE eyes,tiny worn teal collar,ONE old housekey and small empty treat tin. Huge earnest unequal eyes,tiny toothless open oval mouth,patient needy loyalty

A dissonant card sits beside him without asking him to prove his loyalty. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. note: FrizzleBob: Das Bleiben bewahrt vorerst den bisherigen Sinn des Wartens.

name: Freundin Wetterweise
personality: Can be counted on whenever the forecast has already improved.
visual_intent: Fair-Weather Friend Umbrella: broad asymmetrical round ink splat,small cream rain cap,two lashes,tiny berry scarf,ONE small HALF-OPEN teal umbrella carried at flank with curved handle,no actual rain scene. One hooded eye one raised brow,closed toothless dry side-smirk

A dissonant card asks who stayed during the weather she has politely forgotten. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. note: FrizzleBob: Die Verlässlichkeit setzt eine geeignete Wetterlage voraus.
